Messages.Author: Instantiation
Messages.Body:
Quick (hopefully) question regarding Blessing, and blocking timing.

Suppose the situation is thus. I have out a minion with Blessing on
him and my predator is bleeding me with a minion who has dominate. My
predator announces the bleed action first off. Now, suppose my
predator wants to play a conditioning. Who has first opportunity to
declare their stuff? Can he instantly declare "and I play a
conditioning on it", or can I attempt to block before he has that
chance, thus rendering his conditioning unplayable? I don't want to
get into an argument of who can spit out "blocking" or "conditioning"
faster.

Instantiation of the Absurd
